_doc: Title screen (07/11, Sergio: 'precisa ter uma tela inicial'; AMareTitleCamera, MareTitle.cpp): the camera glides through points [x, y, z, pitch, yaw] (world cm, degrees) in a loop of loop_seconds while the main menu is up, at hour (game hours; mid-afternoon: the low sun turned the sea a grassy green in the first try; the clock stands still and the save is not touched). The world keeps living: people walk, the sea moves, boats sail. logo/subtitle are the texts of the title (the commercial name is Coconut Simulator; Maré Alta is the resort inside the game). story: the postcards of a new game before the bus arrival (image = captured in-game, /Game/UI/Intro, always cooked; text is translated). 08/11 (Sergio: 'tela inicial em 2d', 'use o canva para fazer algo bastante detalhado'): art = a detailed 2D painting of the island made in Canva, cover-fitted over the whole screen (the 3D world is not drawn behind it); logo_image = the painted Canva logo (SourceArt/UI/Title, import with mare_title_art.run). Without them the title falls back to the living bay and the text logo.
subtitle: Maré Alta Resort

story.text: Por quarenta verões, Dona Dilce abriu o quiosque da praia antes do sol.
Um dia chegou uma carta: "Meu bem, o quiosque agora é seu."
Você pegou o primeiro ônibus para a costa.
A vila parecia menor... e o mar, do tamanho das lembranças.
